# Test fixture provenance

All third-party `.vl` files in this folder are used only as test inputs for this extension and are not part of the distributed extension package (excluded via `.vscodeignore`). Files are not edited; only line endings may be normalized by Git. The corresponding MIT license texts are kept in `licenses/`.
